story.text:
We met by chance in a pub in Wokingham when I agreed to have a drink with Cat while she waited for her friend to arrive. In walked Callum, and an awkward handshake and 3 lemonades later I knew he was the one for me. From the everyday moments of building our life together in our home by the coast to my favourite memories of watching Callum singing along to Boyzone / Blue / Westlife whenever I have dragged him to a 00s boyband reunion, that feeling has never faded.

So when Callum asked me to marry him, in a cosy cabin somewhere in Kent, it was the easiest ‘yes’ of my life. Now I am so excited to celebrate with you all and finally become Mrs White!

details.title: Dress code
details.text: Black Tie optional. Dinner jackets/tuxedos and formal dresses encouraged. Men please wear dark suits. Women, think long dresses with colour welcomed. Please no white, cream or ivory except shirts.

details.title: Food
details.text: Please provide your allergies and dietary requirements when submitting your rsvp. All allergens, vegan and vegetarian will be catered for if details are provided.

details.title: Gifts
details.text: You being there to celebrate our big day is the best gift we could ask for! However, if you would like to gift us something for our married life, please visit our registry: https://www.weddingshop.com/buy/view/345937

details.title: Children
details.text: Our wedding is a child-free event. Please leave the kids at home and enjoy a responsibility-free party!

details.title: Plus ones
details.text: Unfortunately there is limited space in our ceremony, so only guests named on the invite are able to attend.

details.title: Accessibility
details.text: The venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require any other support, please let us know: eandcwedding27@gmail.com

details.title: Taxis
details.text: Due to the rurality of the venue, taxis must be booked in advance. The wedding finishes at midnight, please plan accordingly. Venue recommended companies can be [found below](#taxis).

details.title: Good to know
details.text:
Smoking and vaping is prohibited on site, please use the car park if required.

Due to venue policy, there are no drinks prior to the ceremony.

The ceremony will start promptly at 1pm. Please arrive at 12.30pm to take your seats.
